rows.label: qst640402_msg0001
rows.name: That's...

rows.label: qst640402_msg0002
rows.name: Is this a winner?

rows.label: qst640402_msg0003
rows.name: It says 'First Prize.'

rows.label: qst640402_msg0004
rows.name: F-f-first prize!?

rows.label: qst640402_msg0005
rows.name: That can't be, mo!

rows.label: qst640402_msg0006
rows.name:
I made sure to remove the first-prize
ticket, mo...

rows.label: qst640402_msg0007
rows.name:
But it clearly says 'First Prize,'
doesn't it?

rows.label: qst640402_msg0008
rows.name: Or are you saying Kasane cheated?

rows.label: qst640402_msg0009
rows.name:
B-but if someone wins it, all the
money Garagara earned will be gone,
mo!

rows.label: qst640402_msg0010
rows.name:
Unlimited daily entry to a Superbian
hot spring does sound expensive.

rows.label: qst640402_msg0011
rows.name: Even so, a win is a win, right?

rows.label: qst640402_msg0012
rows.name: We're taking the prize.

rows.label: qst640402_msg0013
rows.name: Mo-mo... Can't be helped, mo...

rows.label: qst640402_msg0014
rows.name:
Not handing over the prize would stain
a raffle operator's honor, mo...

rows.label: qst640402_msg0015
rows.name:
But taking out the winning ticket was
fine...?

rows.label: qst640402_msg0016
rows.name:
Business here is ruined, mo...
Garagara will go somewhere else, mo...

rows.label: qst640402_msg0017
rows.name: Bye~

rows.label: qst640402_msg0018
rows.name: Well done, Kasane! My beloved friend!

rows.label: qst640402_msg0019
rows.name: Haa...

rows.label: qst640402_msg0020
rows.name:
I can't believe you won an unlimited
pass to Superbia's hot springs...!

rows.label: qst640402_msg0021
rows.name:
Rinne-san, you practically live in the
bath already, don't you?

rows.label: qst640402_msg0022
rows.name: That's different!

rows.label: qst640402_msg0023
rows.name:
I want to soak in the hot spring with
Kasane and everyone and have a tea
party.

rows.label: qst640402_msg0024
rows.name:
You drew the ticket hoping for the
same thing, didn't you, Kasane?

rows.label: qst640402_msg0025
rows.name: No, not really.

rows.label: qst640402_msg0026
rows.name:
Like always, I drew while praying for
everyone to be happy.

rows.label: qst640402_msg0027
rows.name: Mmm...

rows.label: qst640402_msg0028
rows.name:
Looks like one person ended up
unhappy, though...

rows.label: qst640402_msg0029
rows.name:
Well, I want to try the hot spring
too, so let's go to Superbia.
